headline: Seplat Discovers 19 Million Barrels of Oil and 157 Bcf of Gas in Imo State
summary: Seplat has discovered 19 million barrels of oil and 157 billion cubic feet of natural gas in Imo State, Nigeria, uncovering five reservoir intervals.
why: Seplat Energy is an independent Nigerian energy company focused on oil and gas exploration and production in the Niger Delta region. New hydrocarbon discoveries expand the company's reserve base and potential future production capacity.

impacts.name: Seplat Energy
impacts.why: The discovery expands the company's asset base and future reserve potential.
